item.title: Code trace: verify how groom agents use backlog edit
item.intent: Before changing backlog edit flag semantics, read agent prompts to verify they wont break — agents call backlog edit programmatically during grooming and any semantic change could silently corrupt the backlog
steps: Read all .aishore/agents/*.md prompts for backlog edit usage patterns
Search for edit, add, step, ac, scope in agent prompts
Document exactly which flags agents use and how
Verify new replace-array semantics are compatible with agent usage
Document findings in the FEAT-051 grooming notes
acceptanceCriteria: Every agent prompt that references backlog edit is documented
Compatibility of new semantics is confirmed or blockers identified
